cohort.patient_label_rule: malignant if any locked image for that patient is malignant
cohort.patient_score_rule_primary: maximum image score per patient (screening-oriented any-positive aggregation)

raw_split_anomaly.interpretation: All raw-ID collisions cross mass/calcification subdatasets. This may reflect ID reuse or cross-lesion partitioning; identity cannot be proven distinct, so all collided IDs are excluded from both splits.
raw_split_anomaly.policy: exclude every raw patient_id observed in both train and test from both splits

embedding_probe.estimand: held-out linear decodability of malignancy from frozen MedSigLIP embeddings
embedding_probe.model: StandardScaler plus L2-penalized logistic regression; no PCA
embedding_probe.selection_target: mean patient-level AUROC after max-score patient aggregation

threshold_selection.derivation: nested group-CV out-of-fold predictions from training patients only

embedding_probe.tuning: five outer StratifiedGroupKFold splits by patient; within each outer training fold, four-fold patient-grouped C tuning; fold-local scaling and fitting; final C selected by separate five-fold patient-grouped CV on all training data

limitations: 663 archive images lack a verified patient metadata join and are excluded rather than imputed.
24 raw patient IDs occur in both packaged splits; all are conservatively removed from both splits.
The metadata source contains lesion-bearing records; this locked analysis does not represent a general screening population.
The embedding probe is post hoc feature evidence, not a clinically validated screening model.
No independent external cohort was available for transport validation.

preprocessing_and_embeddings.image_preprocessing: PIL decode -> RGB; SiglipImageProcessor resize 448x448 bicubic; rescale 1/255; normalize mean/std 0.5; model.get_image_features; L2 normalize
preprocessing_and_embeddings.score_semantics: independent uncalibrated SigLIP sigmoid per prompt; scores need not sum to one

secondary_evaluation.independent_cross_cohort_validation: not performed; no second patient-qualified external cohort was available, so train/test replication is reported without mislabeling it cross-cohort validation
secondary_evaluation.methods: patient-clustered bootstrap, train/test split replication, CC/MLO and mass/calcification strata, and patient-cluster-robust adjusted logistic regression
secondary_evaluation.purpose: interrogate apparent null zero-shot signal rather than dismissing it
